correctness.rationale: The proof completely classifies all five-word ternary length-three correcting codes by deletion-shadow budgets, gives a nine-position minimum reference for those, and derives a six-position embedding-incidence rigidity forcing \(K_4\). Monotonicity and the global code classification extend the capacity to all T; no finite sample is promoted to an infinite conclusion.
